name: CICF×AGF Guangzhou Anime & Game Festival
blurb: The 19th China International Comics Festival, merging the CICF comics show with the AGF games expo at Guangzhou's Poly World Trade Expo Centre.

editions.evidence: WebSearch of Chinese trade coverage (21jingji.com, jufair.com, bilibili): '举办时间：2026年10月2日-10月5日...举办地点：广州保利世贸博览馆' (19th CICF, combining the CICF comics show and the AGF games expo).

notes: The official site (cicfcn.com) renders only an old, apparently unmaintained homepage (hero images dated 2019, no JSON-LD, no date text, and no links beyond a Comic Artists Conference page), so this edition's dates, venue and attendance (~301,000 visitors, 310 exhibitors, 65,000 sqm, matching the seed note) come from WebSearch of Chinese trade/news coverage rather than the site itself. One source's video title cites '23位嘉宾' (23 guests), so a guest programme does exist, but no guest list could be found on cicfcn.com within budget, so guests is 'unavailable' rather than a guessed list. This edition runs 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-05 — ending on the window's own start date (today) — so it is the current/most recent edition, not a future one. A separate satellite event mentioned alongside it, the Baiyun International Anime & Game Carnival (2026-10-05/06 at a different venue, Baiyun International Convention Centre), reads as a distinct event rather than this festival's own second site, so it is not folded in here. Cover falls back to a hero image from the stale 2019-era homepage render since no current key art could be loaded; og/twitter meta images and logos were both empty on this page.
